title: The Trope Exploit
author: John C. Knudsen
description:
Go for a walk in the forest. Invent a time machine. Steal alien technology as a secret agent. Be an enforcer for a criminal organization. Hunt monsters professionally. Rebuild your emotionally wrecked life. In this eclectic Gamebook/CYOA, you can do all of these things, and more.

Mature themes, tropes, and lame humor.

Optimized for electronic devices.
